cases.label: January actuator lag after software deployment
cases.truth: Deployment was temporally adjacent but not causal; actuator lag came from intermittent bus termination resistance.

cases.label: February sensor reset under thermal stress
cases.truth: High thermal load and a firmware race jointly caused resets; neither alone was sufficient in tested conditions.

cases.label: March retry storm and network degradation
cases.truth: Network degradation triggered retries; retry volume then amplified the degradation. Initial belief reversed direction.

cases.label: April startup stall after certificate renewal
cases.truth: Certificate renewal triggered restart; root cause was a startup dependency cycle exposed by restart timing.

cases.label: May power reset fixed after module replacement
cases.truth: Replacement coincided with reseating harness, controller reset, and power-cycle; causal attribution to module alone remained unresolved.

cases.label: June telemetry spike during cooling demand
cases.truth: Ambient heat caused both cooling demand and sensor drift; cooling demand did not cause the drift.

cases.label: August rollback loop after configuration migration
cases.truth: A configuration schema mismatch directly caused rollback evaluation failure; controlled replay reproduced and isolated it.

cases.label: September intermittent sensor-hub brownout
cases.truth: Two mechanisms remained viable: transient connector resistance or regulator instability. No discriminating test was completed.

cases.label: October CPU spike during control-loop misses
cases.truth: CPU spike was a symptom of runaway diagnostic logging caused by control-loop misses, not the primary cause of misses.

cases.label: November no-failure protection event
cases.truth: Overcurrent protection prevented actuator damage; damage did not occur.

key_invariants: Temporal precedence alone does not establish causation.
Correlation alone does not establish mechanism.
Successful repair is not proof when intervention changes multiple variables.
Trigger and root cause are distinct.
Retrospective narrative is not objective causal truth.
